messages.english: Import field outlines from Google Earth.

translations.zu: Ngenisa imingcele yamasimu evela ku-Google Earth.
translations.st: Kenya meedi ea masimo e tsoang ho Google Earth.
translations.ts: Nghenisa mindzilekano ya masimu leyi humaka eka Google Earth.
translations.ve: Dzhenisani mikano ya masimu i bvaho kha Google Earth.

translations.st: Hlahloba meedi ea masimo e kentsoeng
translations.ts: Kambisisa mindzilekano ya masimu leyi nghenisiweke
translations.ve: Ṱolani mikano ya masimu yo dzheniswaho

messages.english: Design Studio → Planting → Import field outlines

translations.zu: Design Studio → Ukutshala → Ngenisa imingcele yamasimu
translations.st: Design Studio → Ho lema → Kenya meedi ea masimo
translations.ts: Design Studio → Ku byala → Nghenisa mindzilekano ya masimu
translations.ve: Design Studio → U lima → Dzhenisani mikano ya masimu

messages.english: Choose a local KML file, review and select distinct outlines, then add them as new fields. Configure beds or open ground afterwards; map-reference locations are not surveyed boundaries.

translations.zu: Khetha ifayela le-KML elisedivayisini yakho, hlola bese ukhetha imingcele ehlukene, bese uyengeza njengamasimu amasha. Ngemva kwalokho hlela imibhede yokutshala (beds) noma insimu evulekile; izindawo zereferensi yemephu akuyona imingcele ekalwe ngokuhlola umhlaba (survey).
translations.st: Kgetha faele ya KML e sesebedisweng sa hao, hlahloba ebe o kgetha meedi e arohaneng, ebe o e kenya e le masimo a matjha. Ka mora moo lokisa libethe tsa temo (beds) kapa tshimo e bulehileng; dibaka tsa tshehetso ya mmapa hase meedi e lekantsweng ka tlhahlobo ya lefatshe (survey).
translations.ts: Hlawula fayili ya KML leyi nga eka xitirhisiwa xa wena, kambisisa kutani u hlawula mindzilekano yo hambana, kutani u yi engetela yi va masimu lamantshwa. Endzhaku lunghisa timbhedwa to byala (beds) kumbe nsimu leyi pfulekeke; tindhawu ta le mepeni a hi mindzilekano leyi pimiweke hi nkambisiso wa misava (survey).
translations.ve: Nangani faela ya KML i re kha tshishumiswa tshaṋu, ṱolani ni nange mikano yo fhambanaho, ni kone u i dzhenisa sa masimu maswa. Nga murahu dzudzanyani mmbete ya u ṱavha (beds) kana tsimu yo vuleaho; fhethu ha ndaedzo ya mmapa a si mikano yo pimiwaho nga u ela mavu (survey).
